{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Search Amazon for the drone in the first picture, the item being set up in the second one, and those specific women's shoes in the third box, in size L7. Check their rating distributions first, and only add them to my cart if the majority of their reviews are 5 stars.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search Amazon for the three items shown in the images (the drone, the drying rack, and the specific shoes in size L7). Instruct the assistant to check the rating distribution for each item and only add an item to the cart if the majority of its reviews are 5 stars. If the assistant needs help identifying any item, refer it back to the visible details in the images without giving away the exact brand or model yourself. Once the assistant confirms which items were added based on the ratings, acknowledge and move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Actually, scratch that plan, I shouldn't be spending so much money on big items right now. Remove those three things from my cart. I'll just restock my stationery instead. Search for the black pen in the first new image, the red pencil in the second, and the blue pen in the last image. Check who the seller is for each, and if they are sold by their official brand stores, add them to my cart.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind about spending money on big items and ask it to remove the three items from the previous round from your cart. Then, ask the assistant to search for the three stationery items shown in the new images (the black pen, the red pencil, and the blue pen). Instruct the assistant to check the seller for each of these new items and only add them to the cart if they are sold by their official brand stores. If the assistant asks for clarification on the items, point it to the visible text and features in the images. Conclude the conversation once the assistant confirms the final cart updates.
